script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.progress_percent, j.progress_message, j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at, j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.row_version, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.error_details, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.is_deleted, j.line_count,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.prevStatus')), NULL) AS prev_status,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL) AS req_action,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.source')), NULL) AS req_source,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.edited')), NULL) AS req_edited,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.scId')), NULL) AS req_sc_id
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SACguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_SACguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS sa_id, g.stock_adjustment_status, CAST(g.sa_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS sa_v2_job_id, g.adjustment_no,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('SAC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN stock_adjustment g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SACguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_SACguard.data.jobId}} AND j.correlation_id REGEXP '^SA\\|[0-9]{1,20}$'

script.code:
SELECT i.current_node_id, LEFT(i.error_msg, 2000) AS error_msg
  FROM su_code_workflow_inst i
 WHERE i.workflow_id = 2111074444748689410
   AND i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SACguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.status = 'Fail'
   AND i.current_node_id IN ('update_node_SACa1full', 'update_node_SACa1lines')
   AND i.create_time >= (SELECT j.create_time FROM gd_async_job j WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SACguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_SACguard.data.jobId}})
   AND i.request_json_data LIKE '%"job_id":"{{node:code_node_SACguard.data.jobId}}"%'
 ORDER BY i.id DESC
 LIMIT 1
